questions.note: has diagram — question stem is entirely structural (six labeled structures I-VI); the text above is a best-effort description of the structures, not printed prose. Own-chemistry check: (I), (II), (III) and (V) each carry two identical substituents on the stereocentre and are achiral; (IV) and (VI) each carry four different groups and are chiral, matching the paper's marked answer.
